messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — while testing the HubSpot -> SF handoff we hit an edge where enrichment stalls and the RR assign never falls back. Some leads sat unowned for ~12m during the spike.
Aj: Ugh. Which part is stuck? enrichment webhook retries or RR slot lease?
Maria: Looks like enrichment webhook (3rd party) returned 202 + long retry window, and our assign logic waits for enrichment.scores before falling through.
Sam: I pulled logs: 
```
[2026-03-10T15:04:01Z] intake: lead 47ab pending enrichment
[2026-03-10T15:04:25Z] enrich: webhook accepted (202) id=wh_abc
[2026-03-10T15:16:12Z] assign: round_robin skipped - waiting on enrichment.score
```
So we never hit fallback because assign checks enrichment !== null, not elapsed time.
Katie: Can we add a circuit-breaker: if enrichment pending > X sec then assign to overflow pool and mark for post-enrich merge? Need to be careful w/ SDR handoffs (we don't want duplicates).
Derek: +1 for circuit-breaker. Proposal: introduce a short TTL gate in handoff service — default 300s. If elapsed > TTL, mark owner=overflow_pool and tag origin=enrich-deferred. Also add dedupe in outreach to ignore leads with origin=enrich-deferred until enrichment completes.
Maria: That sounds reasonable. Can we make TTL configurable per market/connector? EMEA webhooks are slower so maybe 600s there.
Aj: Config per connector. Implemented as: connector.config.enrich_ttl_seconds fallback to global. Minimal patch to service: 
```
if (lead.enrich_status === 'pending' && now - lead.enrich_started_at > connector.config.enrich_ttl_seconds) {
  assignTo('overflow_pool');
  lead.tags.push('enrich-deferred');
}
```
Sam: We'll need telemetry: counter for enrich_deferred_assign, histogram for time-to-assign; alert when enrich_deferred_assign spikes > 0.5% of daily volume.
Katie: Also need copy in the handoff playbook: how SDRs should treat enrich-deferred leads, and a note for solutions about possible duplicates once enrichment finishes.
Derek: Canary plan: roll TTL change to 10% of traffic for 24h with verbose logging. If churn/duplicates < threshold, roll to 100%. Add an opt-out flag on the rule for VIP accounts.
leadflow-bot: deploy-plan created: PR #1534 -> staging -> canary-10% -> prod. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/handshake/pulls/1534 :rocket:
Maria: Action items: Aj to PR the config + logic, Sam to add metrics & alert, Katie to update playbook and comms, Derek to own canary run. We'll sync tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:
Aj: On it, will tag reviewers.
Katie: I'll draft the SDR note and post to #sales-handbook for feedback.
Derek: I'll stub the canary run doc in the runbook.
Maria: Thanks team — this should close the long-tail unowned leads issue and improve SLA. :thumbsup:
